goals: Give learning and teaching a consistent visual identity
Improve navigation and lesson readability across desktop and mobile
Preserve tested account, assessment, reporting and prerequisite workflows

issues.title: [Design] Responsive workspace shell and account entry experience
issues.implementationDetails: Shared brand, favicon, navy desktop sidebar, compact mobile navigation, active-page indicators, skip link, profile identity, and consistent headings. Redesigned sign-in and registration retain demo access and the Terms and Honor Code gate. Keyboard role selection uses native buttons.

issues.title: [Design] Consistent learning teaching and account screens
issues.implementationDetails: Course covers, real progress/readiness metrics, unified filters, readable lesson canvas, desktop sticky module navigation and collapsible mobile modules. Returning to Learning path resets the selected course. Shared surfaces and headings align directory, gradebook, people, profile, admin and quiz pages; answer selection has explicit text and aria-pressed state.

finalResponsiveChecks.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/design.spec.ts

validation.visualReview: Desktop and mobile screenshots reviewed for authentication, catalog, reader, gradebook, quiz and account layouts. Responsive assertions also cover 320px and 768px widths.
validation.backend: No backend code changes; backend unit suite was not rerun for this design sprint.

limits: Browser checks use Chromium and isolated local MongoDB; external Atlas and other browser engines were not exercised.

followUp.name: Public landing page and account experience
implementationDetails: Added a responsive landing page using the existing Quikz brand and indigo, navy, and lavender palette, with an interactive learning preview, sample quiz feedback, student/faculty perspectives, FAQs, and working public/account navigation.
Added shareable hash routes for login, signup, public catalog and lesson directory with browser history support and public-page titles.
Refined login and signup with password visibility, confirmation validation, inline guidance, error focus, and preserved real authentication and role-specific profiles.
Made the terms gate a native modal dialog with keyboard scrolling, focus containment/restoration, Escape dismissal and preserved scroll/consent requirements.

initialFullBrowserSuite.resolution: Two new registration checks found missing terms-dialog focus restoration; one new responsive check found decorative orbit overflow at 320px. Both causes were fixed.

validation.visualReview: Reviewed desktop and mobile landing, login and signup screenshots; overflow assertions pass at 320, 390 and 768 pixels. Reduced-motion preference is exercised.
validation.backend: No backend changes. Browser checks exercised the real local API and isolated MongoDB, including student and faculty registration.

finalFullBrowserSuite.result: passed after final fixes, including unchanged authenticated-home scenarios

githubVerification.note: Both Sprint 7 issues were already closed as completed and were reverified; no additional GitHub issues were created or closed.

accountAvatarFollowUp.name: Remove login demo shortcuts and prepare Cloudinary avatar uploads
implementation: Login and signup no longer display demo account buttons, embedded credential fillers, or demo email placeholders. Browser suites sign in through the regular form.
Authenticated avatar uploads retain PNG/JPEG/WebP validation, 5 MB and 25 megapixel limits, and sanitized 256x256 WebP output.

Set all three backend CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME, CLOUDINARY_API_KEY and CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET variables to enable signed Cloudinary uploads. With all blank, MongoDB storage remains available. Partial configuration returns 503.

Existing shared avatar API URLs serve legacy MongoDB images or redirect to HTTPS Cloudinary images. Replacement/removal cleans up cloud assets with invalidation; failed saves clean up the new asset. Cleanup failures are logged for operator follow-up.
Cloud storage metadata stays out of account responses and cannot be set through profile edits.

validation.backend: 26 tests passed: accounts.test.ts and deployment.test.ts, including mocked Cloudinary upload/replacement/removal, provider failure, incomplete configuration and failed database save cleanup.
validation.browser: 15 scenarios passed across accounts, design, landing-auth, sprint3 and sprints4-5; desktop login screenshot reviewed.
validation.builds: Backend and frontend production builds passed.
validation.liveCloudinary: Not exercised; provider calls were mocked. Backend credentials are required for a live upload.
